svg.title: EM iterations on one-dimensional data
svg.desc: Four snapshots of EM on 120 one-dimensional points. At the start both components are wide and almost on top of each other, and every tick is a muddy purple (unsure). After ten iterations they have barely moved and the log-likelihood has crept from -263 to -260: EM is crawling off a near-symmetric plateau. By fifteen they have split, and after forty the left bump is blue, the right bump orange, and the log-likelihood has settled at -243.
